source: Old HSK 2.0 levels 1–5, ordered by level then traditional. Every one of the 2548 headwords has an index key. This file's sentences cover the first 1000 (HSK 1–3 and part of HSK 4). HSK 1 has 2 samples, HSK 2 has 3, HSK 3 has 4, and HSK 4 has 5. A sentence token is always one of those words, never a character outside the set, and each token keeps that word's key. Every character also has a meaning part, a sound part, the same-sound set, and the same-part family, the same relations as the character page.
